),
cohort_sizes AS (
  SELECT trunc(signup_date, 'WEEK') AS cohort_week, count(*) AS cohort_size
  FROM workspace.exam_xe7e84.signups

),
user_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    g.cohort_week,

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xe7e84.x1_retention AS
WITH cohorts AS (
  SELECT 
    trunc(signup_date, 'WEEK') AS cohort_week,
    count(distinct user_id) AS cohort_size
  FROM workspace.exam_xe7e84.signups
  GROUP BY 1
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT explode(array(0, 1, 2, 3, 4)) AS week_n
),
cohort_grid AS (
  SELECT c.cohort_week, c.cohort_size, w.week_n
  FROM cohorts c
  CROSS JOIN weeks w
),
user_weeks AS (
  SELECT 
    s.user_id,
    trunc(s.signup_date, 'WEEK') AS cohort_week,
    floor(datediff(a.activity_date, s.signup_date) / 7) AS week_n
  FROM workspace.exam_xe7e84.signups s
  JOIN workspace.exam_xe7e84.activity a 
    ON s.user_id = a.user_id
   AND a.activity_date >= s.signup_date
  WHERE floor(datediff(a.activity_date, s.signup_date) / 7) BETWEEN 0 AND 4
),
active_by_cohort_week AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_week,
    week_n,
    count(distinct user_id) AS active_users
  FROM user_weeks
  GROUP BY cohort_week, week_n
)
SELECT 
  g.cohort_week,
  g.cohort_size,
  g.week_n,
  coalesce(a.active_users, 0) AS active_users,
  round(100.0 * coalesce(a.active_users, 0) / g.cohort_size, 1) AS retention_pct
FROM cohort_grid g
LEFT JOIN active_by_cohort_week a
  ON g.cohort_week = a.cohort_week AND g.week_n = a.week_n
ORDER BY g.cohort_week, g.week_n;
```
